locations.note: The player picks one of four partners and buys two ship tickets to Skagway or Dyea, and earlier departures cost more.
The longer, easier White Pass Trail starts here, where the player can buy supplies, gather information or gamble on rigged games.
The shorter, harder Chilkoot Trail starts here.
After crossing the mountain trail, players build a boat at Lake Bennett.
The river journey ends at Dawson City, where players stake a mining claim.

routes.name: Skagway trail to Dawson City
routes.note: This shows the Skagway branch. Players can instead start the mountain crossing from Dyea.

routes.name: Dyea trail to Dawson City
routes.note: The shorter, more difficult branch crosses the Chilkoot Trail from Dyea before joining the route at Bennett Lake.
